listed_quote.quote: BlackRock Enhanced Government Fund, Inc. (NYSE: EGF) and BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BKT) (each, a “Fund” and together, the “Funds”)

announcement.quote: have approved the reorganization of EGF with and into BKT, with BKT continuing as the surviving Fund (collectively, the “Reorganization”).

outcome_evidence.quote: has completed its reorganization with and into BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. (NYSE: BKT and together with EGF, the “Funds,” and each, a “Fund”) (the “Reorganization”), effective as of the opening for business of the New York Stock Exchange on Monday, March 24, 2025.

deals.notes: Completion stated in the March 24, 2025 425 press release; the target's N-8F (2026-10-09, reason: Merger) also names BlackRock Income Trust, Inc. as the surviving fund.
